title: DSOA instruments-def.yml
description: Validates instruments-def.yml files. The __type field is required for all entries. For fields that define __enum, __type must be 'string' (all enum values are strings). Run pytest test/core/test_instruments_def_schema.py to find missing or incorrect annotations.

attributes.description: Log/span attribute definitions emitted by this plugin.

dimensions.description: Metric dimension definitions emitted by this plugin.

metrics.description: Metric field definitions emitted by this plugin.

event_timestamps.description: Event timestamp field definitions used as event anchors by this plugin.

dql_queries.description: Example DQL queries illustrating how to query telemetry from this plugin.

FieldType.description: The Grail/Dynatrace physical data type of the field.

Stability.description: Stability level of the field annotation.

Semdict.description: Semantic Dictionary provenance of this field.

FieldTypeAnnotation.description: Whether the field is a resource attribute or a signal attribute.

EnumMember.description: A single member of a closed or open enum.

id.description: Unique snake_case identifier for this member.

value.description: The emitted string or numeric value of this member.

brief.description: Short human-readable description of this member.

EnumDefinition.description: Closed or open enumeration definition for a categorical field.

allow_custom_values.description: If true, values outside the members list are permitted.

members.description: List of known enum member definitions.

DqlQuery.description: An example DQL query with metadata for docs and Davis CoPilot.

description.description: Human-readable description of what the query does.

description_copilot.description: Davis CoPilot-optimised description of the query intent.

internal.description: If true, the query is excluded from public documentation.

__is_defined_at_runtime.description: True if the field value is determined at agent runtime.

__enum.description: Enumeration definition for categorical fields. When present, __type must be 'string'.
